summary: Adds a new reusable skill for comparing arbitrary pharmacy refill cycles (e.g., 90-day vs 100-day) based on wholesale, supply, and reimbursement CSVs. The skill generalizes the inline Python approach seen in the trace into a parameterized, deterministic script that handles joins, computes annual revenue/margin, applies threshold-based decision rules, and outputs verifier-ready JSON and Markdown without rounding.
